description: Extended PDI instrument to support recycling chain type: added chain_type field, primary_chain_link, reentry_primary_phase, and C5_reentry_documented; created gold recycling chain PDI instance
notes: PDI template is now v1.1. Three new fields added: chain_type (forward|recycling|ecosystem), primary_chain_link block (recycling only: names the primary chain and re-entry phases), reentry_primary_phase per phase in Module 3 (null for forward chains), C5_reentry_documented in Module 4 (recycling only, max opacity score becomes 5). HTML form updated with conditional chain_type selector, A0b primary_chain_link block, C5 opacity question, and updated scoring logic. Gold recycling PDI has 5 phases (R0 Collection through R4 Re-entry Delivery), with Phase R4 carrying reentry_primary_phase: [4, 5]. All data PROVISIONAL. Phase 8 placeholder removed from template Module 3.
